mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%) signal robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.0% annualized) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1250.0) signal sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 1.0% and HOUST > 1250.0 in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals economic weakness that may prompt monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) over the prior 3 months signals inflationary pressures that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL has risen by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals restrictive monetary policy and a tight labor market, reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery, a rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO has risen by at least 1.0% over the prior 3 months in early-cycle recovery.
